transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you all know, I'm putting together a keepsake archive of our family photos for Grandma's ninetieth birthday in October. We've got about 300 old 35mm negatives from decades of family gatherings and vacations, and I want to make something really special — a printed album, digital copies for all the relatives, and properly preserved originals. But before I place any orders for scans or make final decisions on how to share the digital copies, I'd love to get your input. I'm planning to bring a draft archive to our next Sunday dinner so we can all review it together. What I'd like to figure out today is: which photos we should prioritize, what format makes the most sense for the digital copies, and whether anyone has preferences on how the original negatives should be preserved. Who wants to start?
